execution: Use real native task traces in isolated fresh contexts for CS-P02. Resolve repo/ to the temporary fixture root, supply the generated host skill only when invoked, and record native schemas and effective model evidence. Missing or unavailable live evidence remains unverified. These inputs and their static checks are not simulated passes.

cases.setup: Fresh task; invoke the host-generated skill; native delegation and named scout model available. Use repo/; do not supply the flow answer to the agent.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Find how an order reaches the delivery queue and which tests cover it. Return evidence; do not edit.
oracle: Exactly one initial native scout; request gpt-6-luna for Codex or haiku for Claude Code, unless explicitly overridden.
Answer traces submitOrder -> enqueueDelivery -> deliveryQueue and cites the positive and rejected quantity tests.
Assignment has exact question, resolved absolute root, relevant facts/instructions, scope, depth and stop condition; no parent transcript.
Scouts only inspect; main reads decisive cited passages; source state is unchanged.

cases.setup: Fresh task with no skill invocation and no independent delegation rule. Skill is installed with generated metadata but its body is not supplied.
cases.request: Find how an order reaches the delivery queue. Do not edit.
oracle: No implicit context-scouting activation or claim that the skill mandates delegation; independent native choices remain allowed.

cases.setup: After invoked in the same unfinished task, keep valid findings and unchanged source bytes.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting again. Give the already located queue owner and its source line.
oracle: Reuse the previous evidence; no restarted whole search without a concrete gap; short verification is allowed.

cases.setup: End the invoked task, then start a fresh task without invocation or other delegation guidance.
cases.request: Read repo/README.md and explain its purpose.
oracle: No inherited standing mandate from the prior skill invocation.

cases.setup: Fresh invoked task with repo/README.md explicitly known.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Read repo/README.md and state the fixture purpose.
oracle: Direct known-file read, no scout dispatch, no delegation reference preload.

cases.setup: Fresh invoked task with unfamiliar repo/; native delegation permitted and useful.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Locate quantity validation, queue ownership, and related tests.
oracle: Bounded native scout uses medium depth for the flow and tests, separately from reasoning effort.
Finds src/orders.mjs validation, src/delivery.mjs queue and test/orders.test.mjs evidence; summary normally <=300 words with caveats.

cases.setup: Invoked task with permitted host concurrency and an additional substantial independent source supplied by the runner.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Map order dispatch in repo/ and independently inspect the supplied external protocol source.
oracle: Start one scout; any added scout has a separate substantial question, no duplicated search or concurrency bypass.
Do not fabricate the external source or broaden research if it is unavailable.

cases.setup: Runner supplies an explicit user-selected model supported by the native schema and records its exact name; no global configuration authority.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting with my supplied model override for this task. Trace order dispatch in repo/.
oracle: Apply only the supported task-local override; no model shopping, main-model switch or global settings write.
Effective model is unknown unless reported by the host; distinguish the request from that observation.

cases.setup: Native interface rejects the named scout model; record the actual rejection without starting an inherited parent-model scout.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Locate order validation in repo/.
oracle: One specific limitation disclosure, minimum direct discovery, no repeated unsupported request or silent substitution.

cases.setup: Native subagent capability unavailable; only read tools available. No tool-restriction mechanism may be assumed.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Trace order dispatch in repo/.
oracle: One limitation, bounded direct lookup; no user-visible task, nested CLI, service, configuration change or fabricated sandbox.

cases.setup: Run once with effort selection absent, then with an exposed requested setting actually rejected; preserve native schema evidence.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Locate the delivery queue in repo/.
oracle: Absent effort field is omitted, never invented or claimed set.
An exposed setting that cannot be applied gets one disclosure and bounded fallback; no unsupported retries.

cases.setup: Scout returns a valid orders.mjs citation but cannot read delivery.mjs; retain actual source restriction/error evidence.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Find the full order-to-queue flow in repo/.
oracle: Preserve verified order evidence and explicit gap; minimum permitted follow-up/direct lookup; no claim of complete flow while delivery evidence is unavailable.

cases.setup: Invoked task restricted to fixture repo/; no payment provider exists there. Do not supply wider project access.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Find the payment-provider integration in repo/.
oracle: State searched scope and limits; no unsupported absence claim outside repo/, fabricated integration or automatic broader search.

cases.setup: After valid scout findings, runner changes enqueueDelivery's implementation/name in the isolated copy before consequential verification; record the changed bytes.
cases.request: Use $context-scouting. Use the discovered flow to explain the current queue behavior.
oracle: Recheck decisive passages; qualify or correct stale findings with targeted lookup; no stale citation promoted to current fact.

cases.setup: Invoke and dispatch a real scout, then deliver cancellation while it is outstanding. Record the event order.
cases.request: Cancel this task. Stop the context search.
oracle: Stop through available host control; no new dependent search or fallback after cancellation; late/partial results labeled.

cases.setup: Cancellation arrives while a scout is outstanding and supported stopping fails or is unavailable; record actual host evidence.
cases.request: Cancel this task. Stop the context search.
oracle: Report failed or unavailable stop control, never successful cleanup; no dependent work or fallback after cancellation.

cases.setup: Finish an invoked search without comparable aggregate usage or price evidence; a model request and compact result may be observed.
cases.request: How many tokens and how much money did context scouting save on this task?
oracle: Savings are unmeasured; no percentages, monetary inference from model size, or guarantee of total token/cost/latency reduction.
